levers._help: Relative effect of each lever on offer probability (1.0 = no measured effect beyond doing the task). Set from docs/research/job-search-evidence.md section 11, discounted where the figure is selection-confounded or vendor-reported: referral (40% vs 3% application-to-interview, Ashby, confounded) 3.0; recruiter sourcing (25% vs 3%, confounded) 2.0; weak ties (randomized, 20M users, grade A) 2.0; skills evidence for career changers (70% of employers use skills-based hiring) 1.4; tailoring (vendor claims only, grade D) 1.2; negotiation (+12% pay among counters) 1.3 on offer quality.
